project.title: Nitrogen removal from sulfide-containing wastewater via heterotrophic nitrification-aerobic denitrification: Sulfide-induced shifts in microbial community and metabolism enable high nitrogen removal
project.description: The efficient treatment of sulfide (S2--S)-containing wastewater is currently a challenge in biological treatment due to the toxic effects of S2--S on microorganisms. Compared to autotrophic nitrification-anoxic denitrification process, the heterotrophic nitrification-aerobic denitrification (HN-AD) process exhibits stronger resistance to adverse environmental conditions and enables nitrogen removal in a single aerobic reactor. For now, the impact of S2--S on the performance of HN-AD process and the underlying mechanisms are still unclear.
